name: Operation Laws for the Asymptotic Parent Rate
statement: For nonempty proper represented classes on disjoint grounds, $\gamma(C\times D)\le\gamma(C)+\gamma(D)$. Projection and full reduction do not increase $\gamma$ when their outputs remain nonempty and proper. For $t\ge0$, $\max\{\gamma(C),\operatorname{VC}(C)+t\}\le\gamma(C\times\{0,1\}^t)\le\gamma(C)+t$. If $C$ has $n$ coordinates, then its partial-trace expansion satisfies $\gamma(T(C))\le\gamma(C)+n$. Thus $\gamma=\operatorname{VC}$ is preserved by products of equality cases, visible free or constant coordinates, partial traces, and VC-preserving proper projections.
proof: Regroup $(C\times D)^k$ as $C^k\times D^k$, apply subadditivity of $b$, divide by $k$, and pass to the limit. Apply projection or full reduction independently in every factor for monotonicity. The finite free-coordinate profile construction adds at most $tk$ auxiliaries to $C^k$, while projection and VC dimension give the two lower bounds. Partial trace commutes with products and its finite construction adds at most $nk$ auxiliaries. Combining these inequalities with VC additivity proves preservation of equality.
